article.headline: Omar Croskey scores 20 as South Carolina State tops Maryland Eastern Shore 81-68
article.description: — Omar Croskey's 20 points helped South Carolina State defeat Maryland Eastern Shore 81-68 on Monday night.
article.linkText: Omar Croskey scores 20 as South Carolina State tops Maryland Eastern Shore 81-68

categories.description: South Carolina State Bulldogs @ Maryland Eastern Shore Hawks

event.description: South Carolina State Bulldogs @ Maryland Eastern Shore Hawks

keywords: South Carolina State Bulldogs @ Maryland Eastern Shore Hawks
article.story: PRINCESS ANNE, Md. -- — Omar Croskey's 20 points helped South Carolina State defeat Maryland Eastern Shore 81-68 on Monday night. Croskey added 12 rebounds for the Bulldogs (15-12, 8-3 Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference). Drayton Jones scored 18 points and added six rebounds. Mitchel Taylor shot 3 of 4 from the field and 4 for 6 from the line to finish with 12 points. The Bulldogs upped their win streak to six. The Hawks (4-22, 0-10) were led by Ketron Shaw, who recorded 21 points, seven assists and two steals. Evan Johnson added 10 points and Cardell Bailey finished with nine points and three steals. The loss is the 11th in a row for the Hawks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
